cases.why: The page loads Google Tag Manager (googletagmanager.com) at DOMContentLoaded before any consent interaction. hostnameOf() parses 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=GTM-XXXX' and returns 'googletagmanager.com' (after stripping 'www.'), which is in TRACKING_ORIGINS. perDocument() emits PRIVACY_TRACKER_BEFORE_CONSENT on the request scope keyed by 'googletagmanager.com'. evaluate() produces a finding with ruleId 'privacy-cbf-request' and severity 'serious'.

The page loads the Facebook Pixel SDK from connect.facebook.net before consent. 'connect.facebook.net' is in TRACKING_ORIGINS. A separate finding fires for this origin. GDPR Art. 7 requires prior consent before placing tracking beacons to third-party origins.
